name: COLLBOX_ALT_SET
meaning: Jail and InstantMartian switch the boxes tagged 8 with EnableBoxes/DisableBoxes (door bars / alternate body) (inferred)

name: COLLBOX_CYLINDER
meaning: target treated as a vertical cylinder

name: COLLBOX_SHAPED_MASK
meaning: on the MOVER box: shaped targets are honoured only if any of these bits is set

name: COLLBOX_QUADRANT0
meaning: Train::PlaceCars 0x4fd6a6: the loco's and every car's box set for facing quadrant 0 (rot.y 0); it enables the set of the current quadrant and disables the other three (inferred)

name: COLLBOX_QUADRANT1
meaning: Train::PlaceCars: the box set for facing quadrant 1 (rot.y 0x400) (inferred)

name: COLLBOX_QUADRANT2
meaning: Train::PlaceCars: the box set for facing quadrant 2 (rot.y 0x800) (inferred)

name: COLLBOX_QUADRANT3
meaning: Train::PlaceCars: the box set for facing quadrant 3 (rot.y 0xc00) (inferred)

name: COLLBOX_DOOR_SET
meaning: AutomaticDoor::SetCollision toggles the boxes tagged 0x40000000; RollingCarpet skips them when picking its own box (inferred)
